text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Get the hell over here, punk!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The heck are you doing hitting on my 
precious junior!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't play dumb with me! I've got witness 
testimony right here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I heard you guys have been skippin' out 
on training lately. Somethin' troublin' 
ya—"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mamo-san. Outlaws really are the way to go 
these days, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Set training at set times... Ha! If that 
were all it took to win, nobody'd have a 
hard time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' when I listened to her story, she went 
on about bein' influenced by your 
behavior, and this and that!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me. It's your own lack of 
training, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is way too provocative! Just tell 
'em directly to stop slacking off! Nothin' 
I say is gonna reach those guys right now!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If you can bow your head even lower, I 
might just consider it, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-You!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're asking me for a favor, aren't 
you? If you show some proper sincerity, I 
might consider it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Forget it. Rather than throwing hands 
with you, it'd be way more constructive to 
talk to the student council.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If it were Rudolf, she'd listen properly 
and come up with a proper countermeasure, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... ......Tch! Hey, wait!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's up, did ya change your mind?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...It's a different story if that guy 
tries to initiate some kind of 
'negotiations' at this point.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle it with a match. If you beat 
me, I'll go tell them to behave 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. All I gotta do is not 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, what should we do then! A race 
or whatever, I'll take ya on!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Anything's fine. Hey, Trainer over there, 
you decide the match."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a bit overwhelmed by the two of 
them, the first contest idea that crossed 
my mind was—
choice_data_list:
Run out of material and you lose! An 
endurance showdown of non-stop one-shot 
gags!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"How cliché! Ah, whatever, bring it on! 
Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, now that we got the props 
together, let's do this! We only get one 
shot at this!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind making it best of three, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, an Umamusume never goes back on 
her word! —Rock, paper, scissors, go... 
and strike/guard!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! You better keep your promise, 
Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I see. The "White Lightning", 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Tamamo Cross's juniors 
reportedly went back to being well-behaved 
kids without further issue.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An endurance gag contest!? Well, I don't 
mind, but... can Sirius really pull that 
off?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Quick gags, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sirius Symboli approached Tamamo 
Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Say what!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She pulled off a magnificent roundhouse 
kick, right over Tamamo Cross's head.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, don't freak out. It's just a quick 
party trick, a party trick.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Hey, let me have a go too! My party 
trick is a roundhouse kick!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're not gonna reach it. Looks like 
I win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hold your horses, I'll pass it over to ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how the contest turned out 
after that... the juniors' behavior seemed 
to return to normal without any issues.
